notes.title: Argonisos - Graphics Update

notes.title: CYCLADEA Update 11/07/2022
notes.notes:
Hey Cycladeans!

We decided we want to give you an even better experience in Cycladea than we already had in store for you. On that basis, we are pushing back the Early Access Release date for 03/03/2023.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43055671/077437ffcd6db3db5cfe6dd7db174f4b1b5b9f90.png[/img]

To reward you for your patience the Early Access version is going to be a lot closer to the end product we intent to release later in 2023!!!

CONTENT LIST AVAILABLE ON EARLY ACCESS
-------------------------------------------------
[list]
[*] [b]Random World Generation[/b] (using an automatic seed system, each world will be unique)
[*] [b]Day/Night cycle System[/b]
[*] [b]Dynamic Weather System[/b] (experience a challenging weather system)
[*] [b]Fog and Mist System[/b]
[*] [b]Dynamic and Volumetric Lighting[/b] providing beautiful scenery for unique screenshots
[*] [b]Multiple Character Creation System[/b] (create as many Greek warriors as you want)
[*] [b]Single-Player and Multi-player System[/b] (play the game with up to 10 players)
[*] [b]Modular Building System[/b] (build structures any way you like)
[*] [b]Character Customisation[/b] (create unique Greek warriors)
[*] [b]Multiple World Creation[/b] (create as many Worlds as you want)
[*] [b]Crafting System[/b] (craft weapons, tools and equipment to help you survive)
[*] [b]Cooking System[/b] (hunt, cook and eat to be strong)
[*] [b]13 Skills[/b] to upgrade (sprinting, sneaking, axe-wielding, etc.)
[*] [b]Automatic Level-Up[/b] (the more you use a skill, the better you become at it)
[*] [b]Health and Stamina System[/b]
[*] [b]Sailing System[/b] (build a sailboat and travel the seas)
[*] [b]Save System[/b] (save whenever you want)
[*] [b]Auto-Save System[/b] (in case you forget to, we have your back by auto-saving every 60sec)
[*] [b]Cheat Sheet[/b] (All Cheats and Codes will be fully available to everyone)
[*] [b]Fighting System[/b] (Engage in epic battles with mobs, enemies and powerful Bosses)
[*] [b]Base Building System[/b] (build your own base and upgrade it to get awesome buffs)
[*] [b] Gathering System[/b] (collect stones, bones, pieces of wood, flowers, etc. from the ground)
[*] [b] Mining System[/b] (chop down trees, kill creatures, brake rocks and mineral masses, etc.)
[*] [b] Fast-Travel System[/b] (place rods in the ground and have the ability to fast-travel between them)
[*] 6 out of 10 Biomes fully developed
[*] 14 weapons
[*] 19 armor pieces with 5 armor sets
[*] 18 shields
[*] 4 arrow types
[*] 8 handheld tools
[*] 36 building pieces
[*] 17 furniture and decoration models
[*] 10 equipment models
[*] 18 animals and enemies
[*] 69 materials to craft, build, cook and farm
[*] 42 food recipies
[/list]

Don't miss out! Follow the game here > [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2108370/Cycladea/]Cycladea[/url]

notes.title: CYCLADEA Update 10/18/2022
notes.notes:
Hey Cycladeans!

We have prepared a roadmap to show you what will be added to the game in order to be available on the Early Access Release coming on November 11th.

----- ALREADY INCLUDED -----

[list]
[*] Biome System with 10 different Biomes (Pedias, Yleos, Valtos, Oros, Okeanos, Nisia, Acheron, Erebos, Olympos)
[*] Procedurally Generated World with seeds system
[*] Skybox for Day & Night with cycle
[*] Weather System
[*] Water and Sea System
[*] Unique Grass and general flora for every biome
[*] 10 different Trees giving unique resources
[*] 12 different ground assets (bushes, plants, branches and more)
[*] Mineable Rocks
[*] Mineable Masses for Alloy, Electrum, Copper, Iron and Gold
[*] Mineable Frost Crystals
[*] Mineable Nature Blood Pools
[*] Cave Entrances for Giant's, Bear and Cyclops caves
[*] Entrances for Gorgon Temples
[*] Sun and Moonlight Rays and Flares
[*] Dust and Wind Particle System
[/list]

----- 10/21/2022 -----

[list]
[*] Weather System variations
[*] Wood and Stone Building System
[*] Crafting System
[*] Mining System
[*] Battle System
[*] Battle, Mining, Weather VFX
[*] Rabbits, Deers, Foxes, Hogs, Seagulls, Fish, Ravens, Wolves and Bears
[*] Enemies: Dryads (4 variations), Giants, Gorgons (2 Variations), Wolves (4 variations), Sirens and Bears
[*] Leather, Deer, Fox and Bronze Armor Sets
[*] Crude, Lightstone and Bronze Weapons / Shields / Tools
[*] Pedias Boss: Minotaur
[*] Yleos Boss: Manticore
[*] Random Giant's Cave Generator
[*] 10 Gorgon Temple Interiors
[/list]

----- 10/28/2022 -----

[list]
[*] Character Customisation System: Male and Female with Hair and Beard Style and Colour
[*] Valtos Boss: Medusa
[*] Character Conditions System: 14 Conditions (Rested, Zeus Blessing, Cold, Stunned and more)
[*] Character Special Powers
[*] Furniture and Decorations
[*] Cooking System
[*] Resting System
[*] Sailing System
[*] Simple Raft and Sailboat
[*] 28 Foods and Recipes
[*] 14 Potion Recipes
[*] Character Abilities System: Health and Stamina
[*] Character Skills System: 13 Skills (Sprinting, Jumping, Sneaking, Axeman and more)
[*] Shields Colour and Painting Variations
[*] 69 Building and Crafting materials added (Stones, Hides, Miscellaneous and more)
[*] Audio FX and Music
[/list]

----- 11/04/2022 -----

[list]
[*] Oros Boss: Typhoness
[*] Ancient Greek Temples scattered in the world
[*] Zeus Statue to pray to
[*] Main Menu UI
[*] Pause Menu UI
[*] Multiplayer with private and public server options System
[*] Multiple Character Creation System
[*] Multiple World Generation System
[*] Adaptive Game Difficulty System
[*] Easter Eggs
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] Dev commands Option
[/list]

----- 11/11/2022 -----

[list]
[*] Check everything before Early Access Release ;)
[/list]

----- ONWARDS -----

After Early Access is Released we will continue to add more content in order to reach a massive list of content in the game, totalling 10 biomes, 10 Bosses, 1 Super-Boss (the goddess Hera), 100 mob creatures, 150 different weapons, 140 different armor pieces, 30 different shields with variations, 20 different projectiles, 20 power abilities, 7 different building materials, 200 crafting and cooking materials and 8 ships (sailing and warships).

We are excited to see our project coming to life and hope you enjoy the world we created for you!
Wishlist Cycladea [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2108370/Cycladea/]by clicking here[/url]

Cheers!

notes.title: CYCLADEA Update 10/14/2022
notes.notes:
Hey Cycladeans!!!

We are Happy to Announce that we just added the materials for you to be mining in the game!!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43055671/28c066efde657b9d1a0266a4d6e87313a78b69dc.png[/img]

Apart from Trees, Bushes, Plants and Rocks you will now be able to mine a total of 8 different Materials
- Stone
- Alloy
- Copper
- Electrum
- Frost Crystal
- Iron
- Gold
- Marble

You will be able to Craft Weapons, Shields, Armors, Projectiles and many more as well as Build you Base the way only you can do it!

More info and screenshots from the building system coming soon!

Cheers!
